steps.content:
Four hours after Korryn's capture
In front of the Security Bureau at WhiteSands Market
A group of desert bandits lie bound and tied on the ground outside the assembly hall. The jarring scene draws everyone's attention.
You stand near your captives as the clerk beside you exclaims in amazement.

steps.speaker: Security Bureau Clerk
steps.content: Thank you for your patience, Chief. We've finished processing all the suspects you brought in—
The Security Bureau clerk shuffles through the papers, organizing all the checked-off bounty notices.

steps.speaker: Security Bureau Clerk
steps.content: Everyone who tried to catch these cunning, stealthy bandits complained that they're slipperier than eels. You're the first one to not only find their hideout, but catch them all in one sweep!

steps.speaker: Security Bureau Clerk
steps.content: As expected of the MBCC Chief! You really are remarkable!
I just happened to be passing by. It was no trouble at all.
Happened to be passing by? No trouble at all?
You look across the square and see Korryn, who is under task force surveillance, next to the tied-up desert bandits. Catching your eye, she grins and waves.
—An hour and a half ago, she wore that exact same smile.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: This is the place—head west, that's definitely the right way—
With one hand cuffed to the armrest, Korryn gestures dramatically with the other, pointing out directions for the sand ship.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Gimme another chance, Chief! My brain is just a bit fuzzy. With a few more tries, I'll definitely figure out which way is right!
I've already given you two chances.
Your eyes drift to a cracked window of the sand ship, its once-pristine exterior now covered in scratches.
The first time, you led us to a desert temple full of booby traps. The second time, you led us straight into a massive pit of quicksand.
Why don't you save us both time and tell me what you've got planned this time?
Korryn leans back, resting her chin in her hand with a smile that spells nothing but trouble.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Aww, but where's the fun in spoiling the surprise?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: We're almost there, Chief. You'll find out soon enough!
Before she can finish speaking, the sand ship's cabin door bursts open.

steps.speaker: Task Force Agent
steps.content: Chief! We've been led to a desert bandit hideout. They're attacking us from three directions!

steps.speaker: Task Force Agent
steps.content: If we retreat the way we came, we could get surrounded. Awaiting your orders, Chief!
You turn to Korryn, who moves her hand from her cheek to flash you a victory sign.
What are you going to do about it? Her voice seems to taunt in your ear. You turn to the task force member, ignoring her provocation.
Well, we're here now. Let's take care of them quickly.
And—assign someone to guard Korryn. Don't let her slip away. Everyone else, move to engage!

steps.speaker: Task Force Agent
steps.content: ...Chief, Korryn says she just remembered another location.

steps.speaker: Task Force Agent
steps.content: This... this is the <color=#fb9259>fourth Tuco location</color> she's given us, we...
You look at the task force agent before you. You remember him well—a promising young officer, both capable and dependable, who's always kept his weapons and gear polished to perfection.
Now his pants are torn, and his face and hair are caked with sand. He hides his face behind his armor, clearly too embarrassed to speak.

options: You've been through a lot today.

choices.text: You've been through a lot today.

steps.content: Let's move out. Bring Korryn—we'll discuss this further back on the ship.
As you lead the task force back toward the sand ship, an enthusiastic security clerk calls out after you.

steps.speaker: Security Bureau Clerk
steps.content: Thank you for dealing with the bandits! Be careful on your journey—WhiteSands has been having unusual weather lately, with lots of sandstorms—
The officer's voice fades into the distance, drowned out by the bustling sounds of the market.

Your group keeps to one side of the road. The market isn't crowded today, so you're not worried about getting separated by the crowd. But as you pass an alley, a small dark figure suddenly darts out and crashes right into you.
Ow! That hurts!
After crying out in pain, the scrawny, grimacing child tumbles to the ground with a thud, clutching his head.

steps.speaker: Task Force Agent
steps.content: Is that... a child?
A task force agent, who had instinctively drawn his weapon, puts it away and reaches down to help the fallen child up.
The child silently pushes away the helping hand and makes a dash for the crowd. Before anyone else can react, you quickly reach out and grab his arm.

steps.speaker: Gaunt Child
steps.content: Let go! Y-you... let go of me!
As the task force agent watches in surprise, your wallet slips out from the child's hand and drops to the ground.
I won't turn you in to the authorities, but I need you to return what you've taken. I still need 'em.

steps.speaker: Gaunt Child
steps.content: I'm sorry! Th-this is my first time stealing, I have younger siblings who are starving... I'm sorry! Please let me go, I'll never do it again, I—
A knowing voice drifts in, cutting off the child's sobbing.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Ah... the classic WhiteSands pickpocket routine—sick mother, drunk father, starving siblings, and a poor broken soul...

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: I used the exact same story when I got caught as a kid. Come on, haven't you folks updated your script in all these years?
The boy freezes as his lie is exposed, then begins to struggle even more desperately.
Korryn bends down to pick up your wallet, but instead of returning it to you, she dangles it teasingly in front of the boy.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: So, Chief, what should we do with them? This little rascal's not even worth putting on a wanted poster. Since we can't get a bounty, maybe we should find a nice quiet spot to give him a good beating, then toss him out in WhiteSands to teach him a lesson—
As Korryn's threats grow more and more outrageous, the boy becomes truly terrified at the thought of being fed to sandworms. His brave facade crumbles into real tears.
You let out a sigh and put an end to Korryn's little performance by taking your wallet from her hands.

options: I believe this wallet belongs to me.

choices.text: I believe this wallet belongs to me.

steps.content: You remove your ID and magnetic cards from the side pocket, close the wallet, and hand it back to the child—along with all the cash inside.

steps.speaker: Gaunt Child
steps.content: Huh? W-what are you...?
The tears in the boy's eyes are frozen in disbelief. Too stunned to speak, he can only stare at you in bewilderment.
Whether or not you're telling the truth, stealing is wrong. But I hope that once you're able to support yourself, you'll choose a more honorable—and safer—way of living. Otherwise...
You point to the nonchalant woman standing beside you.
If you get caught again, you might end up like her—getting dragged around town for everyone to see.
Go. This money should keep you fed for a while.
The boy, tears still on his face, thanks you profusely. As he turns to leave, Korryn pats his shoulder and, lowering her voice, discreetly slips a bullet into his pocket.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Take this and find a bearded man called Andrei at the far east end of the market.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Tell him Korryn sent you. He'll take you in—the work's tough, but at least you'll get fed... Oh, and sweetie? You really need to work on those fake tears. That performance was painful to watch...
The task force agent glances at you, but you shake your head. Korryn exchanges another few words with the child before standing up to bid him farewell.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Sorry to keep you waiting, Chief. Shall we head back to the ship?

options: Who is this bearded man Andrei?

choices.text: Who is this bearded man Andrei?

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Hmm? Oh, he's an old business partner of mine who later quit to run a kebab stall. He still deals in secondhand intel now and then... That kid's got guts though. He'll go places.
...Doesn't sound like the most legitimate line of work.
Korryn lets out a quiet chuckle but says nothing more. She turns to walk with you toward the approaching sand ship.
Set course back to the main WhiteSands route.
Before Korryn can say anything, you enter the cabin and issue the command.
Korryn is escorted back to her seat, where she crosses her legs and sits with the enthusiasm of a player returning to the game table.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Oh good, round after round we go. Adventure games are my favorite!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: So Chief, remember that new address I gave you? I'd be happy to repeat it if need be!
You silently take the seat across from her and look into her eyes.
Before we continue this tedious adventure game of yours, I have a question.

options: Korryn, what are you really after?

choices.text: Korryn, what are you really after?

steps.content: The woman falters for a moment before letting out a scornful laugh.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Money, of course! You didn't figure that out from my interrogation? Why else would I kidnap someone?
Yes, that's one of the things you're after—but it's not your only goal.

A typical kidnapper would have given up Hella's location and fled by now. But she shows no urgency, nothing like you'd expect from someone in her position. Instead, she's been using Hella's whereabouts as bait, sending you on a wild goose chase through WhiteSands.
Is she after the ransom she never received? No—your investigation tells you she's after far more than that.

I checked the detention records. Over the past 6 months, you've turned in 7 desert bandits—all associates of that same group we just ran into. They want vengeance on you and your partners, swearing to beat up anyone connected to you.
And then there's the temple and the quicksand... These were all targets you had your eye on.
You've been using the MBCC's forces to clear the path for you and Tuco.
I may not see your endgame or know what you're planning... Maybe you're even using Hella as bait to trick me. But none of that matters...
If you're just using me, fine—but leave Hella out of this!
Korryn, what is Tuco really planning?!
The woman in the hat pauses, reassessing you with a long look. Something new flickers in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: <size=25>Heh... little mouse, your precious Chief is much sharper than you...</size>
Her voice is too soft for you to hear.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Oh, just lamenting. Our big hero wants to end the show before we even reach Act Two.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Let me clarify two things. First, yes, I did want to get close to you, but Tuco has nothing to do with it. They don't know I'm here, and they don't know I caught your little mouse. They're completely uninvolved.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Second, your deductions are mostly right, but there's one detail you got wrong...
The woman tilts up her hat brim with a defiant smirk.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Who said I wasn't looking for a chance to escape?
(Transition, shaking effect, white out)

Suddenly, the cabin floor shakes violently and tilts—the sand ship must have hit something. In the ensuing chaos, Korryn grabs a chair and hurls it at the already-cracked window, then leaps through the shower of glass shards.
There's no time to weigh your options. Without a second thought, you launch yourself through the window after her—
The momentum of your fall sends you colliding with Korryn.
Tangled together, you two tumble and roll down the sand dune until a shallow depression brings you to a stop.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Ahhh... That hurts...
Korryn pushes herself up from the sand, wincing as she caresses where you collided with her.
Behind you, the damaged, out-of-control sand ship carves a long trail through the desert as it speeds away into the distance.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: Oh, my dear Chief! If I jump out of a sand ship, you'll jump out of one too?!

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: If you're dead set on chasing me, at least use some common sense! When you jump onto a rocky sand dune, you need to protect your head. If you crack your skull open, your little mouse will never let me hear the end of it...
The bounty hunter's words trail off. A fierce wind picks up, and you both instinctively turn to look.

Less than a hundred meters away, a massive sandstorm devours the horizon, turning everything into a hazy amber void. Through the murky tempest, huge otherworldly shapes writhe in and out of view, their shrieks slicing through the wind.

options: Is this... the Tide of Ashes?

choices.text: Is this... the Tide of Ashes?

steps.speaker: Security Bureau Clerk
steps.content: Thank you for dealing with the bandits! Be careful on your journey—WhiteSands has been having unusual weather lately, with lots of sandstorms and sand beast attacks—
This Tide of Ashes is moving faster, reaching further, and towering higher than any you've seen before.
Worst of all... it's so fast. It appeared without a sound, then closed in almost instantly.

steps.speaker: Korryn
steps.content: —Quit dawdling! Run!
The wind erases your footprints the moment they form. Through the amber haze, fanged beasts howl as they lunge for your clothes.
Korryn grips your hand with one hand while firing her rifle with the other to drive back the creatures.
Through the wall of swirling sand, you vaguely make out the silhouette of a building ahead.
To the left—cough... the left! We can take cover over there!
The howling wind thrusts sand into your mouth when you try to speak. Unable to talk, you and Korryn silently feel your way toward the shelter.
The wind grows stronger by the second. Korryn's gunfire becomes more frequent, and the creatures' shrieks are practically next to your ear... then, finally, your hand touches the door of the shelter.
You shove the door open and dive inside, pulling Korryn along with you.
